gripOrHq.title: Loan from Chiba
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Snowball
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
[1]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Top Runners' Conference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: Private LDL Access
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: R&D-Protocol Files
rig.rulesText: A: Make a run on R&D, but instead of accessing cards, look at the top five cards of R&D.

ice.title: Vacuum Link
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.

root.title: Roving Submarine
root.rulesText:
Install only inside a subsidiary data fort. This fort may be run only if you installed or advanced a card inside or on this fort during your last turn.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.
